name: afb-flow-status
description: Shows the Agent Flow Board item this Claude Code conversation is working on: tab name, reference, phase, percent and status.

server.title: Board address
server.description: The address of your Agent Flow Board, for example https://afb.arbenger.com

org.title: Organisation
org.description: The organisation name (slug) in the board address, for example arbenger. The hooks of your repo must send to the same organisation.

token.title: Read token
token.description: A personal access token with the read permission only, made on Connect a tool. It expires after 90 days at most.
